equipment_type: Lighting control system (BACnet IP subsystem device)
applies_to: Lutron Quantum lighting control systems (Quantum 3.1) with BACnet; one physical subsystem device per subsystem, typically one per floor.
summary: Each Quantum subsystem is a physical BACnet IP device that routes to the area virtual devices (listed separately). The subsystem device holds the subsystem-wide objects: master load shed, master Hyperion shade control, the roof-mount cloudy-day sensor, and one set of objects per timeclock, timeclock event and state variable.
notes: Area-level objects (light level, scenes, occupancy, power) are on the area virtual devices; see the Quantum BACnet Area Virtual Device list.

Only the first instance of each range is listed: timeclock enabled 1000-1999, timeclock enable command 2000-2999, state variables 4000-4999, timeclock event enabled 5000-5999, event hour 6000-6999, event minute 7000-7999.
Timeclock objects in 1000-1999 and 2000-2999 pair by offset; event enabled, hour and minute pair by the last three digits.
A timeclock appears on every subsystem device; write the same instance on each subsystem to change it everywhere.

source.title: BACnet PIC Statement for Quantum Subsystem Physical Devices using Quantum Version 3.1

integration.summary: Use the subsystem device for building-wide actions: master load shed (BV 2), Hyperion shade control (BV 3) and timeclock enable/disable (MV 2000 range). Area lighting itself is read and commanded on the area virtual devices.

minimum_points.name: Master Loadshed Enabled

minimum_points.why: Enable or disable a timeclock schedule

minimum_points.name: Roof-Mount Cloudy Day Sensor: Subsystem Status

integration.enable: BACnet IP is built into the Quantum processor as a licensed software option; device IDs come from the Base and System numbers set in the Quantum configuration software. No separate BMS enable point exists.
integration.remote_sensors: A BMS sensor can stand in for the roof-mounted cloudy-day sensor by writing BV 4 (Dark overrides Hyperion shades to open).
setup: BACnet IP; the subsystem device is the router for its area virtual devices.
Device ID = Base + System + 1; Base default 1760000, System 0-127, set in the Quantum software.
gotchas: Writing 1 (Disable Permanently) to a timeclock enable command stops that timeclock until it is enabled again.
Enable With Catch Up replays missed events from up to the last seven days.
Load shed only dims areas that have load shed allowed on their area device.
